title: Respond to a medication dose on Apple Watch
narrative: As a patient, I want my paired Apple Watch responses to update the real medication event and administrator dashboard.

environments.connected-pair: Isolated Firebase Auth, Firestore and Functions emulators with paired iPhone 17/iOS 26.5 and Watch Series 11 46mm/watchOS 26.5. Actual WatchConnectivity, not injected Watch state. The clock accelerates real iPhone AlarmKit dates. Physical Watch alarm mirroring/sound/haptics are not verified by these captures.

preconditions: An administrator creates and publishes the dose through the dashboard.
The patient signs in with the generated Auth Emulator Google identity and follows the schedule through the iPhone UI.
No credentials or fixture schedules are installed in the Watch app.
Watch sends actual response commands; only an acknowledged phone write changes its displayed state.
Exact PNG comparison; two-second maximum condition waits and no arbitrary test delays.
The patient uses the visible Refresh from iPhone control on initial Watch launch. This story does not claim a two-second bound for first-time system pairing/background context delivery.
